packageRules.description: Datastore majors are migrations, not bumps -- never automerge them. These images read an on-disk format written by the previous major, and a new binary will refuse data it considers too old rather than converting it. On 2026-10-02 PR #242 ('Update mongo Docker tag to v9') was opened by Renovate, auto-approved, and merged by kodiak with no human in the loop; mongo 9 then exited 62 on data at featureCompatibilityVersion 8.2 and took vtt-maps, joanna-showcase and michael-showcase down for 17 hours. Dropping the automerge label is what blocks the merge, because .kodiak.toml sets require_automerge_label = true. The PR still opens, so the upgrade stays visible -- it just waits for someone to run the migration first.
